summary: Authored 3 AM Incident Runbook for the OrderFlow service.
evidence: Defined clear single-source-of-truth service variables and team contacts at the top.
Built a 0-30s triage decision matrix linking symptoms directly to recovery paths.
Formatted all recovery workflows into strictly numbered steps with 100% copy-pasteable terminal commands.
Included concrete decision branches for API crashes, Celery worker stalls, PostgreSQL pool saturation, and emergency Helm rollbacks.
Established a 15-minute escalation protocol with pre-formatted Slack templates and PagerDuty routing.
